title: Local Noetherianity descends along an etale covering
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{T_a\to T\}_{a\in A}$ be a jointly surjective etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. If every $T_a$ is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], then $T$ is locally Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 034C (lemma-Noetherian-local-fppf), descent direction, specialized to an etale covering; etale coverings are fppf by Topologies Tag 021N (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf).

proof.text: Let W be an arbitrary affine open subscheme of T. Base-changing the given jointly surjective etale family to W gives a jointly surjective etale family {W\times_TT_a\to W}_{a\in A} by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change]. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product], each W\times_TT_a is the open subscheme t_a^{-1}(W) of T_a, with the restriction of t_a:T_a\to T as its map to W. The affine-base refinement [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement], applied to this family over the affine scheme W, supplies finitely many affine opens U_j\subseteq t_{a(j)}^{-1}(W) whose induced etale maps U_j\to W are jointly surjective; as t_{a(j)}^{-1}(W) is open in T_{a(j)}, each U_j is an affine open subscheme of T_{a(j)}. Each U_j is an affine open of the locally Noetherian scheme T_{a(j)}, so [pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth] says that its ring of sections A_j is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 034C, proof lines 4767-4781, after restricting to an affine open of the base; affine refinement is Topologies Tag 0218.

proof.text: Write R for the ring of sections of W and let A=\prod_jA_j. The maps U_j\to W are etale, hence flat by [def-weil-etale-morphism], and the affine flatness criterion [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-affine-criterion] makes each R\to A_j flat. Therefore R\to A is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-flat-modules]. Joint surjectivity means that every prime of R has a prime above it in some A_j; composing that prime with the projection A\to A_j gives a prime of A above it, so Spec(A)\to Spec(R) is surjective. [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat] then makes R\to A faithfully flat. A finite product of Noetherian rings is Noetherian by the componentwise ideal argument, so [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian] gives that R is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 034C, affine descent direction (lines 4772-4779), using Algebra Tag 033E; etale-to-fppf flatness from Topologies Tag 021N.

proof.text: The affine opens W of T form an affine open covering. Since Steps 1–2 prove that every such W has a Noetherian ring of sections, choosing any affine open cover and applying the definition of locally Noetherian schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth] gives that T is locally Noetherian.

Source: Stacks descent.tex Tag 034C (lemma-Noetherian-local-fppf, lines 4761-4781), descent direction via Algebra 033E; affine refinement is Topologies lemma-etale-affine (0218, topologies.tex 766-778). The statement is a correct etale specialization of 034C and is not weakened, and the parent lem-trf-polarized-fine-log-etale-descent uses it exactly as stated. Step 1: the base-change leaf applies, and the refinement leaf applies because W is affine. Step 2: etale implies flat by the definition; the affine flatness criterion gives R->A_j flat and the finite-product leaf gives R->A flat. The primes pulled back along the projections give surjectivity on Spec, so 00HQ gives faithfully flat; the product of Noetherian rings is Noetherian (elementary, via idempotents), and 033E gives R Noetherian. Step 3 is the definition of locally Noetherian and is elementary. Edge cases T empty (m=0, R=0) and the identity cover both work. No new nodes; rg for 034C and fppf/faithfully-flat locally-Noetherian descent finds only the item and its parent, so there is no duplicate. No cycle, no SGA. The tool_uses entry for the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian is accepted. FIX (C1): step 1 called the refined U_j affine opens of T_{a(j)}, but the refinement leaf gives affine opens of W x_T T_a; identifying that product with the open t_a^{-1}(W) needs the existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product.
